description: Under the DOCS command-reference policy, quoted <...> placeholders are validated against manifest argument slots, enum alternations against the declared vocabulary (manifest values union proto enum values), literal example values against descriptor-derived constraints, and unquoted placeholder groups parse leniently while emitting a style finding carrying a byte-exact quoted autofix.

requirements.description: Under Request.Policy DOCS, a quoted "<name>" placeholder must match the manifest argument slot it fills (positional name, flag name/alias, or bound proto field) with placeholder_name_mismatch emitted as a warning on drift, and a quoted "<a|b|c>" alternation must exactly equal the effective vocabulary (manifest values union proto enum values) with enum_placeholder_mismatch emitted as an error naming the expected list. Non-DOCS policies must keep the pre-existing strict behavior bit-for-bit.
requirements.title: DOCS-policy placeholder and enum-alternation validation

validation.notes: The implementation-plan-authoring SKILL.md snippet reaches argument_shape_validated with its enum alternation checked.
A drifted alternation yields enum_placeholder_mismatch naming the expected vocabulary.
Every non-DOCS policy keeps strict parsing and the invalid_arguments code.

requirements.description: Literal example values in DOCS-policy snippets must be validated against descriptor-derived constraints where they exist — type parse, buf.validate numeric bounds, string length bounds, uuid format, proto enum membership, and manifest values membership — emitting invalid_literal_value naming the violated constraint, and skipped silently when no constraint metadata exists (including when the descriptor image is absent).
requirements.title: Descriptor-derived typed literal validation

validation.notes: Type, bounds, length, uuid, and enum-membership table including the placeholder-skips-typed-checks case.

requirements.description: Under DOCS policy, a balanced non-nested unquoted <...> group outside quotes must parse leniently as a single placeholder token reaching the same semantic checks as its quoted form, emitting exactly one unquoted_placeholder warning per group whose fix field carries the byte-exact snippet with every group double-quoted. Genuine shell operators outside placeholder groups (pipes, redirects, substitution, chaining) must remain hard unsupported_shell_syntax errors under every policy, and no shipped guidance may recommend TOKEN_VALUE placeholders.
requirements.title: Lenient unquoted-placeholder parsing with byte-exact quoted autofix

validation.notes: Unquoted groups tokenize with byte-exact fixes; nested/unterminated groups and real operators stay hard errors.
One unquoted_placeholder finding per group, each carrying the identical full-snippet fix.
Redirection guidance recommends quoted placeholders and never TOKEN_VALUE.
